Fractal, Snowball’s design system

A company design system that writes “brutal shadows” into its color documentation.

Source
snowball-tech/fractal on GitHub
Creator
Snowball
Made
2023–present
Style
Neo-brutalism (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Playful, direct
Evidence
Downloaded and inspected packages/fractal/public/images/cover_fractal.png (3200 × 1800) from the repository. Licence read through the GitHub API. The Storybook site was not captured.
Reviewed
25 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The README describes “the open-source mono-repository for the design reference, components libraries and documentations of Fractal, Snowball’s design system”. Repository created 19 June 2023; MIT License, copyright 2023 Snowball. Documentation: fractal.snowball.xyz.

Listed under “Complete Design System” in the CC0 Awesome Neobrutalism list.

Observed

  • Color swatch cards with black outlines and solid black shadows offset down and right.
  • Flat pastel and bright tones: mint, violet, yellow, cyan, and a primary pink #FF8ACD, with pure black #000000 as the secondary color.
  • The secondary color’s usage note lists “Strokes & Brutal shadows styles”.
  • Large heavy sans-serif headings on an off-white page.

Why it belongs

A production design system, not a demo kit. It shows the style formalized as tokens: one black for all strokes and shadows, and a tonal scale for each bright.

Borrow

Reserve one color token for all outlines and hard shadows. Give each bright hue a few lighter tones for large backgrounds.

What to review next

  • Capture the Storybook and snowball.xyz to measure outline width and shadow offset.
